requirements.title: Separate MP3 Audio Files
requirements.definition: The requested voice-over recordings must be delivered as separate audio files, with MP3 accepted as the delivery format.
requirements.boundary_note: File separation and MP3 format are attributes of one delivery-packaging mechanism; audio editing and creation of alternative performances are independently actionable Requirements.

requirements.title: Alternative Voice-over Takes
requirements.definition: Provide alternative recorded performances from which the client can select a preferred voice-over direction.
requirements.boundary_note: This covers production of alternative recording artifacts, not their pacing, emotional delivery, post-production editing, or final managerial approval.

requirements.title: Smooth Voice-over Pacing
requirements.definition: The voice-over must use natural, smooth pacing and avoid excessive pauses, particularly in the final sentence.
requirements.boundary_note: Pacing and pause placement can be revised and evaluated independently from the recording's energy, inspirational quality, and emotional tone.

requirements.title: Energetic and Inspiring Voice-over Tone
requirements.definition: The voice-over must sound energetic, lively, inspiring, and subtly proud without sounding overacted.
requirements.boundary_note: Energy, liveliness, inspiration, pride, and restraint form a tightly coupled emotional-delivery direction; pause placement and pacing remain separately testable.

requirements.title: Editing of Selected Voice-over Takes
requirements.definition: The two selected candidate takes must be edited before being delivered separately for management review.
requirements.boundary_note: Post-production editing is independently actionable from recording alternative takes and from packaging the resulting files separately.

unresolved_candidates.description: One of the two final candidate takes was approved, but the observable history does not identify which take; no selected-take identity should be inferred.
